steps.note: Buy low, sell high, one transaction. Sweep left to right carrying the cheapest price seen so far — the best sell is always against that low.
Day 0: price 7 is the cheapest so far. No profit selling on the day you buy.
Day 1: price 1. Selling against the low 7 (day 0) yields -6. And 1 is a new low to buy at.
Day 2: price 5. Selling against the low 1 (day 1) yields 4. New best trade!
Day 3: price 3. Selling against the low 1 (day 1) yields 2.
Day 4: price 6. Selling against the low 1 (day 1) yields 5. New best trade!
Day 5: price 4. Selling against the low 1 (day 1) yields 3.
Best profit is 5 — buy day 1 (1), sell day 4 (6). One pass, O(n).
